subject: Exec clearance: NorthPoint onboarding — sanctions flag & non-standard retention
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>; Darren Cole <darren.cole@northpoint.energy>, NorthPoint Legal <legal@northpoint.energy>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Exec clearance: NorthPoint onboarding — sanctions flag & non-standard retention

Team — looping you in on a NorthPoint opportunity that needs exec-level clearance. Summary:
- ARR: ~$420k ARR first year (annualized run rate); 3-year commitment requested.
- Ask: customer requests a non-standard data retention term (retain for 7 years) and wants a 25% list discount tied to volume.
- Risk: our screening returned a sanctions-related flag on a minority beneficial owner (not in SDN list but flagged by third-party provider). See attached sanctions report and KBIS.
- Timing: customer has fiscal approval window that closes ~Nov 15 and is asking for a signed contract + PO by then.

Attachments: northpoint_sanctions_report.pdf, northpoint_kbis_signed.pdf, pricing_term_sheet_NorthPoint_v3.pdf

Requesting:
1) Exec signoff to proceed with onboarding despite the screening flag (conditional on enhanced KYC/controls)
2) Approval (or guidance) on discount cap and whether Deal Desk may approve the retention deviation
3) If approved, ask Legal to prepare a redline with required indemnities/audit rights and Security for monitoring obligations.

Next steps: I can run a short call with Legal/Compliance + NorthPoint to get the additional docs if helpful.

— Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
From: Darren Cole <darren.cole@northpoint.energy>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: NorthPoint Legal <legal@northpoint.energy>, procurement@northpoint.energy
Date: 2026-11-03T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Exec clearance: NorthPoint onboarding — sanctions flag & non-standard retention

Marcus — thanks for the quick heads up. We absolutely want to move forward; Q4 budget approvals are tight so a quick turnaround will help.
I attached a beneficial ownership declaration and an internal memo clarifying the flagged investor is a minority shareholder based in the UK and has no sanctions history. We’re happy to provide more identity proof and a board resolution.

Attachments: beneficial_ownership_declaration.pdf

Can we get a provisional approval while you complete the extra verification? We can sign a conditional SOW if needed.

— Darren Cole
VP, Procurement | NorthPoint Energy
darren.cole@northpoint.energy | +1 212-555-0177
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Exec clearance: NorthPoint onboarding — sanctions flag & non-standard retention

Marcus — good capture. A few quick notes from GTM:
- Discount: Deal Desk standard guidance is max 15% list for this tier without exec approval. 25% is material; needs explicit signoff.
- Retention: 7 years is outside our standard (we typically offer 1–3 years depending on product). Legal & Security must weigh in — this is high-sensitivity.
- Timeline: I hear the Nov 15 window; we should be pragmatic but not rush compliance.

Please fill out the attached exec_escalation_form.docx and add more KYC items to the Drive link. Once we have Compliance feedback we can propose a conditional commercial package.

Attachments: exec_escalation_form.docx

— Marissa Cole
Senior AE Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Security-Compliance Team <security@redwood.com>, Legal <legal@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T09:00:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Exec clearance: NorthPoint onboarding — sanctions flag & non-standard retention

Quick preliminary assessment before Legal completes the review:
- The third-party screening flagged a beneficial owner due to proximity to a watchlist entry; our checks show no direct SDN or OFAC listing. Risk classification: Low/Medium.
- Recommended controls if we proceed: enhanced ongoing monitoring, contractual covenant to notify Redwood of any ownership change, monthly audit logs available to Redwood, plus right to pause ingestion on reasonable suspicion.
- Retention concession: suggest a compromise — 3 years with a defined carve-out process for legal requests rather than a blanket 7-year retention.
- Commercial: I recommend we cap the discount at 18% (one-time onboarding credit can be structured separately) unless CRO/Head of Sales provides more latitude.

I’m attaching a short compliance_memo with details. Legal: please propose specific contract language for the monitoring and ownership-notification clauses.

Attachments: compliance_memo.pdf

— Karthik Iyer
Head of Go-to-Market Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>; Darren Cole <darren.cole@northpoint.energy>
Cc: Legal <legal@redwood.com>, Finance <finance@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T16:20:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Exec clearance: NorthPoint onboarding — sanctions flag & non-standard retention

Team / Darren — after review, I’m authorizing onboarding to proceed conditionally with the following executive approvals and controls:
1) Commercial: One-time 10% onboarding credit plus a 12% ongoing discount (pricing cap applies) for the first 24 months. Any additional concession requires CRO approval.
2) Retention: We will NOT accept 7-year blanket retention. Approved compromise: 3-year retention with documented exceptions handled via Legal approval and with monthly access logs provided to Redwood.
3) Compliance controls: NorthPoint must deliver the additional KYC (BO declaration, board resolution) and accept contract language for: breach-notification, ownership-change notification, and right-to-pause ingestion for suspected sanctions exposure.
4) Legal to prepare redlined SOW + indemnity clause; Finance to record approved commercial concession and update deal record.

Darren — if you can confirm acceptance of these conditions I’ll ask Legal to issue a conditional SOW for signature. We expect completion of the outstanding KYC by 11/13 to preserve the Nov 15 procurement window.

— Laura Bennett
VP, Global Sales | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Darren Cole <darren.cole@northpoint.energy>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: NorthPoint Legal <legal@northpoint.energy>, procurement@northpoint.energy
Date: 2026-11-09T18:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Exec clearance: NorthPoint onboarding — sanctions flag & non-standard retention

Laura / Marcus — thanks for the clear path. NorthPoint accepts the conditional terms:
- We agree to provide the remaining KYC docs by 11/12.
- We accept the 3-year retention with audit access and notification obligations.
- Commercial terms accepted (10% onboarding credit + 12% ongoing discount for 24 months).

Attached is our signed PO indicating intent to proceed; please send the conditional SOW/DocuSign and we will return signed copies ASAP. Goal: go-live target Nov 30.

Attachments: signed_procurement_PO.pdf

— Darren Cole
VP, Procurement | NorthPoint Energy
